Solidity 0.8.24 transient storage (EIP-1153) for flash-loan tracking,      which auto-clears at the end of the transaction \u2014 eliminating stale-state bugs.      Addresses audit findings: C1 (pre-rotation), C2 (vault/orchestrator accounting),      C3 (dust), C4 (ZK binding). CHANGES vs the previously-circulated draft of this library:   1. FIXED (would not compile) \u2014 `requirePreRotationReconciliation`,      `requireVaultReconciliation`, and `requirePostExecutionReconciliation` were declared      `view` but each contains `emit`. Solidity treats event emission as a state mutation      for view-purity purposes and rejects it at compile time. All three are now ordinary      (non-view) internal functions.   2. ADDED \u2014 `pendingVaultProofsCount(state)` view helper so a contract can expose its own      gate's pending-proof count to a *different* contract (e.g. Vault exposing it to      Orchestrator). Named distinctly from the `pendingVaultProofs` struct field it reads \u2014      giving a library function the same name as a struct field it's called on causes an      ambiguous-lookup compile error. The gate only ever sees its own contract's      storage/transient state \u2014 a caller in another contract can't reach into it directly,      so the owning contract needs a getter built on top of this.   3. NOTE for integrators \u2014 `using Gate for Gate.GateState;` alone is NOT sufficient to      call `requireVaultReconciliation` / `requirePostExecutionReconciliation` as      `token.requireVaultReconciliation(...)`, since their first parameter is `IERC20`, not      `GateState`.
